subject: general
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate choice.**

Hard to believe that these people can justify and ______ such sickening behaviour!
solution:
The correct answer is: **Rationalize**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Rationalize**" means to justify or explain something in a logical or reasonable way. (किसी बात को तार्किक या उचित तरीके से उचित ठहराना या समझाना)
 
• The word "rationalize" is used in this context because it means to provide reasons or excuses to make something seem more acceptable or understandable, even when it may be morally wrong or objectionable.
 
• In the sentence, the speaker is expressing disbelief that these people are able to find reasons or justifications for their sickening behaviour, implying that their attempts to rationalize it are difficult to comprehend.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Essentialize**: To reduce something to its essential elements. (किसी चीज़ को उसके आवश्यक तत्वों तक कम करना)
 
• **Scandalize**: To shock or offend with immoral behaviour. (अनैतिक व्यवहार से आघात पहुँचाना या ठेस पहुँचाना)
 
• **Tantalize**: To tease or tempt someone with something they cannot have. (किसी को ऐसी चीज़ से चिढ़ाना या प्रलोभित करना जो उसके पास नहीं हो सकती)
